This channel was designed as an educational tool for Massage Therapy Students by Rev. William Fulp, a Licensed Massage and Bodywork Therapist. On this channel, you will see videos of him demonstrating all kinds of massage therapy modalities done in segments, as well as assessments, and skillsets important to clinical reasoning and critical thinking applications. 
Rev. William Fulp has been a licensed Massage Therapist since 2010, and a Massage Therapy Educator since 2012. He has had vast experience in Hospital/Medical Centers rendering both in- and out-patient massage therapy treatments. He has also worked with D1 Sports Medicine and two athletic programs on the collegiate level. 
Rev. William Fulp is a LMBT, MMP, CMT, CDT, KTP, Sports MT, and Clinical Education Coordinator of the Therapeutic Massage Program of Forsyth Technical Community College. 
So, please hit "Like" and "Subscribe." Feel free to leave comments or ask questions!
This channel is not monetized!
